rows.text: The joint plenary meeting in place of a party convention held at party headquarters on 22 September 2008 elected 麻生太郎幹事長 23rd president: 527 voters (386 party Diet members, 141 prefectural representatives); 麻生 351, 与謝野馨 66, 小池百合子 46, 石原伸晃 37, 石破茂 25.

locator.section: date line 【平成２０年 ９月２２日】; headline 第２３代総裁に麻生太郎幹事長を選出 両院議員総会; first paragraph

rows.text: 臼井日出男, chair of the presidential election administration committee, announced 麻生候補's election (麻生候補の当選を高らかに報告) at the meeting on 22 September 2008.

locator.section: first paragraph, sentence beginning 臼井日出男総裁選挙管理委員長が

rows.text: Under the heading 麻生新総裁あいさつ（全文）, 麻生新総裁 says he has just now been chosen 23rd president of the LDP (ただいま第２３代自由民主党総裁に選出をいただきました), after an unexpected presidential resignation (総裁辞任, the predecessor unnamed).
